verdict.rationale: Cactus is an on-device inference engine with offline chat. Its Needle model can return sentence vectors for local search, but that is a developer building block, not a documented 'chat with your documents' feature. Nothing in the pack shows document ingestion, automatic retrieval, or RAG chat over user files.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can chat with my own documents entirely offline using automatic retrieval-augmented generation
